definition_of_done: The complete source-derived autonomous operating loop is represented by enforceable requirements and Completion Gate facts.
Cursor operates only through the governed provider and bounded supervisor contracts.
A real fixture golden journey and staged unattended qualification are required before activation or completion.
Traceability, tests, documentation, security, rollback, and durable handoff state agree.
exclusions: No claim that Cursor authentication, Privacy Mode, cloud execution, Windows behavior, or unattended qualification has passed before durable evidence exists.
No lifecycle-only PRs, one-transition deliverables, direct secret exposure, direct external writes, or mock-only completion claims.
observability_impact: Persist Cursor run IDs, prompt and context digests, base/head SHAs, files, tests, cost, duration, outcomes, checkpoints, receipts, and readbacks without secret values.
rollback_recovery_consideration: Disable provider:cursor-cli, preserve durable checkpoints and branches, restore the verified pre-change backup, and continue through another qualified provider without changing canonical project truth.
security_impact: Keep Cursor quarantined until authentication, Privacy Mode, representative qualification, Windows verification, rollback, and external-write isolation are evidenced.

acceptance_criteria.statement: REQ-PDEF-0011 and the Completion Gate preserve and enforce the complete SRC-014/SRC-015 operating outcome.
Cursor is configured as a quarantined provider with tracked rules, privacy exclusions, bounded planning, issue-specific artifact audit, and fail-closed external writes.
